mapper.select: select * from menu
select store_nm from store where store_no=#{storeNo}

select row_number() over(partition by month, year order by totalAmount desc) as rank, month, year,menu_no, menu_nm,totalAmount from ( select extract(month from s.selling_date) as month, extract(year from s.selling_date) as year, sd.menu_no,menu_nm, sum(sd.selling_amount) as totalAmount from selling_detail sd join selling s on s.selling_no = sd.selling_no join menu m on sd.menu_no=m.menu_no where s.store_no = #{storeNo} and extract(month from s.selling_date)=#{month} and extract(year from s.selling_date)=#{year} group by extract(month from s.selling_date), extract(year from s.selling_date), sd.menu_no,menu_nm ) subquery order by year, month, rank

select rank, month, year, menu_no, menu_nm, total_amount from ( select row_number() over( partition by extract(month from s.selling_date), extract(year from s.selling_date) order by sum(sd.selling_amount) desc ) as rank, extract(month from s.selling_date) as month, extract(year from s.selling_date) as year, sd.menu_no, menu_nm, sum(sd.selling_amount) as total_amount from selling_detail sd join selling s on s.selling_no = sd.selling_no join menu m on sd.menu_no = m.menu_no join store st on st.store_no = s.store_no where s.store_no = #{storeNo} and extract(month from s.selling_date) = #{month} and extract(year from s.selling_date) = #{year} group by extract(month from s.selling_date), extract(year from s.selling_date), sd.menu_no, menu_nm ) subquery where rank between 1 and 5 order by year, month, rank
select distinct extract(year from selling_date) as year from selling s, store st where s.store_no=st.store_no and st.store_no=#{storeNo} order by year
select distinct extract(month from selling_date) as month from selling s, store st where s.store_no=st.store_no and st.store_no=#{storeNo} order by month

SELECT st.STORE_NO, st.STORE_NM ,TO_CHAR(s.SELLING_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') AS monthS, SUM(s.SELLING_TOTAL) AS monthlySales FROM STORE st JOIN SELLING s ON st.STORE_NO = s.STORE_NO where st.store_no= #{storeNo} and extract(year from selling_date)=#{year} GROUP BY st.STORE_NO, st.STORE_NM, TO_CHAR(s.SELLING_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY st.STORE_NO, monthS

SELECT st.STORE_NO, st.STORE_NM ,TO_CHAR(sb.store_budget_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS monthY, SUM(sb.store_budget) as monthlyYSales FROM store_budget sb, store st WHERE sb.store_no=st.store_no and sb.store_budget_ty = 2 AND st.store_no = #{storeNo} and extract(year from store_budget_date)=#{year} GROUP BY st.STORE_NO, st.STORE_NM,TO_CHAR(sb.store_budget_date, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY st.STORE_NO, monthY

WITH lastYearSales AS ( SELECT st.STORE_NO, st.STORE_NM, extract(year from s.SELLING_DATE) as year, SUM(s.SELLING_TOTAL) AS SALES FROM STORE st JOIN SELLING s ON st.STORE_NO = s.STORE_NO WHERE st.store_no = 1 AND TO_CHAR(s.SELLING_DATE, 'YYYY') = #{year}-1 GROUP BY st.STORE_NO, st.STORE_NM, extract(year from s.SELLING_DATE) ), thisYearSales AS ( SELECT st.STORE_NO, st.STORE_NM, extract(year from s.SELLING_DATE) AS year, SUM(s.SELLING_TOTAL) AS SALES FROM STORE st JOIN SELLING s ON st.STORE_NO = s.STORE_NO WHERE st.store_no = #{storeNo} AND TO_CHAR(s.SELLING_DATE, 'YYYY') = #{year} GROUP BY st.STORE_NO, st.STORE_NM,extract(year from s.SELLING_DATE) ) SELECT TY.store_no, TY.STORE_NM, NVL(LY.SALES, 0) AS lastYearSales, NVL(TY.SALES, 0) AS thisYearSales, CASE WHEN NVL(LY.SALES, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(((NVL(TY.SALES, 0) - NVL(LY.SALES, 0)) / NVL(LY.SALES, 1)) * 100, 2) END AS growthRate FROM lastYearSales LY full outer join thisYearSales TY ON LY.year =#{year}-1 and ty.year=#{year}

WITH MONTHS AS ( SELECT TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{year}||'01', 'YYYY-MM'), LEVEL-1), 'YYYY-MM') AS monthS FROM DUAL
CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 12 ), lastYearSales AS ( SELECT st.STORE_NO, st.STORE_NM, TO_CHAR(s.SELLING_DATE, 'MM') AS month, SUM(s.SELLING_TOTAL) AS SALES FROM STORE st JOIN SELLING s ON st.STORE_NO = s.STORE_NO WHERE st.store_no =#{storeNo} AND TO_CHAR(s.SELLING_DATE, 'YYYY') = #{year}-1 GROUP BY st.STORE_NO, st.STORE_NM, TO_CHAR(s.SELLING_DATE, 'MM') ), thisYearSales AS ( SELECT st.STORE_NO, st.STORE_NM, TO_CHAR(s.SELLING_DATE, 'MM') AS month, SUM(s.SELLING_TOTAL) AS SALES FROM STORE st JOIN SELLING s ON st.STORE_NO = s.STORE_NO WHERE st.store_no = 1 AND TO_CHAR(s.SELLING_DATE, 'YYYY') = #{year} GROUP BY st.STORE_NO, st.STORE_NM, TO_CHAR(s.SELLING_DATE, 'MM') ) SELECT TY.store_no, TY.STORE_NM, m.monthS as tm, NVL(LY.SALES, 0) AS lastYearSales, NVL(TY.SALES, 0) AS thisYearSales, CASE WHEN NVL(LY.SALES, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(((NVL(TY.SALES, 0) - NVL(LY.SALES, 0)) / NVL(LY.SALES, 1)) * 100, 2) END AS growthRate FROM MONTHS m LEFT JOIN lastYearSales LY ON TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(m.monthS, 'YYYY-MM'), 'MM') = LY.month LEFT JOIN thisYearSales TY ON TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(m.monthS, 'YYYY-MM'), 'MM') = TY.month ORDER BY m.monthS
select distinct extract(year from store_order_date) year from store_order order by year desc
select distinct extract(month from store_order_date) month from store_order order by month

select row_number() over(order by total desc) as rank, item_nm, year, month,total from(select i.item_nm,i.item_no, extract(year from s.store_order_date) as year, extract(month from s.store_order_date) as month, sum(store_order_amount) as total from store_order_detail sd, store_order s, item i where sd.store_order_no=s.store_order_no and i.item_no = sd.item_no and s.store_order_status=1 and extract(year from s.store_order_date)=#{year} and extract(month from s.store_order_date)=#{month} group by extract(year from s.store_order_date),extract(month from s.store_order_date),i.item_nm,i.item_no)

select to_char(store_order_date,'YYYY-MM') as monthS, sum(store_order_price) AS monthlySales from store_order so, store_order_detail sod where so.store_order_no=sod.store_order_no and so.store_order_status=1 and extract(year from store_order_date)=#{year} and store_order_sum is not null group by to_char(store_order_date,'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY monthS

SELECT to_char(head_budget_date,'YYYY-MM') as monthY, sum(head_budget) as monthlyYSales from head_budget where head_budget_ty=2
and extract(year from head_budget_date)=#{year} group by to_char(head_budget_date,'YYYY-MM') order by monthY

select m.menu_no, m.menu_nm, sum(sd.selling_amount) as totalMenu from selling s, selling_detail sd, menu m where s.selling_no=sd.selling_no and m.menu_no=sd.menu_no and extract(year from s.selling_date)=#{year} and extract(month from s.selling_date)=#{month} group by m.menu_no, m.menu_nm

select i.item_no, i.item_nm, sum(store_order_amount) as totalItem from store_order so, store_order_detail sod, item i where so.store_order_no = sod.store_order_no and i.item_no=sod.item_no and so.store_order_status=1 and extract(year from so.store_order_date) =#{year} and extract(month from so.store_order_date) =#{month} group by i.item_no, i.item_nm

with months as( select to_char(add_months(to_date(#{year}||'01','YYYY-MM'),level-1),'YYYY-MM') as monthS from dual
connect by level <=12 ), lastYearSales as( select to_char(so.store_order_date,'MM') as month, sum(store_order_price) as sales from store_order so, store_order_detail sod where so.store_order_no = sod.store_order_no and extract(year from store_order_date)=#{year}-1 group by to_char(so.store_order_date,'MM') ), thisYearSales as( select to_char(so.store_order_date,'MM') as month, sum(store_order_price) as sales from store_order so, store_order_detail sod where so.store_order_no = sod.store_order_no and extract(year from store_order_date)=#{year} group by to_char(so.store_order_date,'MM') ) select m.monthS,nvl(ly.sales,0) as lastYearSales, nvl(ty.sales,0) as thisYearSales, CASE WHEN NVL(LY.SALES, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(((NVL(TY.SALES, 0) - NVL(LY.SALES, 0)) / NVL(LY.SALES, 1)) * 100, 2) END AS growthRate from months m, lastYearSales ly, thisYearSales ty where TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(m.monthS, 'YYYY-MM'), 'MM')=ly.month and TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(m.monthS, 'YYYY-MM'), 'MM')=ty.month order by m.monthS

with lastYearSales as ( select extract(year from so.store_order_date) as year, sum(store_order_price) as sales from store_order so, store_order_detail sod where so.store_order_no = sod.store_order_no and extract(year from store_order_date) = #{year} - 1 group by extract(year from so.store_order_date) ), thisYearSales as ( select extract(year from so.store_order_date) as year, sum(store_order_price) as sales from store_order so, store_order_detail sod where so.store_order_no = sod.store_order_no and extract(year from store_order_date) = #{year} group by extract(year from so.store_order_date) ) select #{year} - 1 as lastYear, #{year} as thisYear, nvl(ly.sales, 0) as lastYearSales, nvl(ty.sales, 0) as thisYearSales, case when nvl(ly.sales, 0) = 0 then 0 else round(((nvl(ty.sales, 0) - nvl(ly.sales, 0)) / nvl(ly.sales, 1)) * 100, 2) end as growthRate from lastYearSales ly full outer join thisYearSales ty on ly.year = #{year} - 1 and ty.year = #{year}
select store_nm, store_no from store

SELECT st.STORE_NO, st.STORE_NM ,TO_CHAR(s.SELLING_DATE, 'YYYY') AS yearS, SUM(s.SELLING_TOTAL) AS yearlySales FROM STORE st JOIN SELLING s ON st.STORE_NO = s.STORE_NO where TO_CHAR(s.SELLING_DATE, 'YYYY')=#{year} GROUP BY st.STORE_NO, st.STORE_NM, TO_CHAR(s.SELLING_DATE, 'YYYY') ORDER BY st.STORE_NO, yearS

select row_number() over(order by T.yearlySales desc) as rank, T.* from( SELECT st.STORE_NO, st.STORE_NM ,TO_CHAR(s.SELLING_DATE, 'YYYY') AS yearS, SUM(s.SELLING_TOTAL) AS yearlySales FROM STORE st JOIN SELLING s ON st.STORE_NO = s.STORE_NO where TO_CHAR(s.SELLING_DATE, 'YYYY')=#{year} GROUP BY st.STORE_NO, st.STORE_NM, TO_CHAR(s.SELLING_DATE, 'YYYY') ORDER BY st.STORE_NO, yearS)T
mapper.insert: insert into selling(selling_no, store_no, selling_date) values(nvl((SELECT MAX(selling_no) FROM selling),0)+1, #{storeNo}, sysdate)
insert into selling_detail(selling_detail_no, selling_no, menu_no, selling_amount) values()

SELECT NVL(MAX(selling_no),0) + 1 FROM SELLING
INSERT INTO SELLING(SELLING_NO, STORE_NO, SELLING_DATE, SELLING_TOTAL) VALUES(#{sellingNo},#{storeNo},SYSDATE, #{sellingTotal})

SELECT NVL(MAX(selling_detail_no),0)+1 FROM selling_detail
INSERT INTO SELLING_DETAIL(SELLING_DETAIL_NO, SELLING_NO, MENU_NO, SELLING_AMOUNT) VALUES(#{sellingDetailNo},#{sellingNo},#{menuNo},#{sellingAmount})
mapper.select: SELECT T1.MONTH_LIST MONTH_S , NVL(T2.MONTHLYSALES,0) MONTHLY_SALES , NVL(T3.MONTHLYYSALES,0) MONTHLY_Y_SALES , (NVL(T2.MONTHLYSALES,0) - NVL(T3.MONTHLYYSALES,0)) PROFIT , NVL(T4.GROWTHRATE,0) GROWTH_RATE FROM ( SELECT TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{year}||'01', 'YYYYMM'), LEVEL - 1), 'YYYY-MM') AS MONTH_LIST FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 12 ) T1 LEFT OUTER JOIN ( select to_char(store_order_date,'YYYY-MM') as MONTHS , sum(store_order_price) AS MONTHLYSALES from store_order so, store_order_detail sod where so.store_order_no=sod.store_order_no and so.store_order_status=1 and extract(year from store_order_date)=#{year} and store_order_sum is not null group by to_char(store_order_date,'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY monthS ) T2 ON(T1.MONTH_LIST = T2.monthS) LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT to_char(head_budget_date,'YYYY-MM') as MONTHY , sum(head_budget) as MONTHLYYSALES from head_budget where head_budget_ty=2 and extract(year from head_budget_date)=#{year} group by to_char(head_budget_date,'YYYY-MM') order by monthY ) T3 ON(T1.MONTH_LIST = T3.MONTHY) LEFT OUTER JOIN ( with months as( select to_char(add_months(to_date(#{year}||'01','YYYY-MM'),level-1),'YYYY-MM') as monthS from dual connect by level <=12 ), lastYearSales as( select to_char(so.store_order_date,'MM') as month, sum(store_order_price) as sales from store_order so, store_order_detail sod where so.store_order_no = sod.store_order_no and extract(year from store_order_date)=#{year}-1 group by to_char(so.store_order_date,'MM') ), thisYearSales as( select to_char(so.store_order_date,'MM') as month, sum(store_order_price) as sales from store_order so, store_order_detail sod where so.store_order_no = sod.store_order_no and extract(year from store_order_date)=#{year} group by to_char(so.store_order_date,'MM') ) select m.MONTHS, CASE WHEN NVL(LY.SALES, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(((NVL(TY.SALES, 0) - NVL(LY.SALES, 0)) / NVL(LY.SALES, 1)) * 100, 2) END AS GROWTHRATE from months m, lastYearSales ly, thisYearSales ty where TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(m.MONTHS, 'YYYY-MM'), 'MM')=ly.month and TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(m.MONTHS, 'YYYY-MM'), 'MM')=ty.month order by m.MONTHS ) T4 ON(T1.MONTH_LIST = T4.MONTHS) ORDER BY T1.MONTH_LIST

select T1.MONTH_LIST MONTH_S, T2. store_nm,nvl(T2.monthlySales,0) MONTHLY_SALES ,nvl(T3.monthlyYSales,0) MONTHLY_Y_SALES ,(nvl(T2.monthlySales,0)-nvl(T3.monthlyYSales,0) ) profit,NVL(T4.GROWTHRATE,0) GROWTH_RATE from( SELECT TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{year}||'01', 'YYYYMM'), LEVEL - 1), 'YYYY-MM') AS MONTH_LIST FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 12 ) T1 left outer join( SELECT st.STORE_NO, st.STORE_NM ,TO_CHAR(s.SELLING_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') AS monthS, SUM(s.SELLING_TOTAL) AS monthlySales FROM STORE st JOIN SELLING s ON st.STORE_NO = s.STORE_NO where st.store_no= #{storeNo} and extract(year from selling_date)=#{year} GROUP BY st.STORE_NO, st.STORE_NM, TO_CHAR(s.SELLING_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY st.STORE_NO, monthS )T2 on T1.MONTH_LIST = T2.monthS left outer join (SELECT st.STORE_NO, st.STORE_NM, TO_CHAR(sb.store_budget_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS monthY, SUM(sb.store_budget) as monthlyYSales FROM store_budget sb, store st WHERE sb.store_no=st.store_no and sb.store_budget_ty = 2 AND st.store_no = #{storeNo} and extract(year from store_budget_date)=#{year} GROUP BY st.STORE_NO, st.STORE_NM,TO_CHAR(sb.store_budget_date, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY st.STORE_NO, monthY) T3 ON(T1.MONTH_LIST = T3.MONTHY) left outer join ( WITH MONTHS AS ( SELECT TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{year}||'01', 'YYYY-MM'), LEVEL-1), 'YYYY-MM') AS monthS FROM DUAL
CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 12 ), lastYearSales AS ( SELECT st.STORE_NO, st.STORE_NM, TO_CHAR(s.SELLING_DATE, 'MM') AS month, SUM(s.SELLING_TOTAL) AS SALES FROM STORE st JOIN SELLING s ON st.STORE_NO = s.STORE_NO WHERE st.store_no =#{storeNo} AND TO_CHAR(s.SELLING_DATE, 'YYYY') =#{year}-1 GROUP BY st.STORE_NO, st.STORE_NM, TO_CHAR(s.SELLING_DATE, 'MM') ), thisYearSales AS ( SELECT st.STORE_NO, st.STORE_NM, TO_CHAR(s.SELLING_DATE, 'MM') AS month, SUM(s.SELLING_TOTAL) AS SALES FROM STORE st JOIN SELLING s ON st.STORE_NO = s.STORE_NO WHERE st.store_no = #{storeNo} AND TO_CHAR(s.SELLING_DATE, 'YYYY') = #{year} GROUP BY st.STORE_NO, st.STORE_NM, TO_CHAR(s.SELLING_DATE, 'MM') ) SELECT m.monthS , CASE WHEN NVL(LY.SALES, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(((NVL(TY.SALES, 0) - NVL(LY.SALES, 0)) / NVL(LY.SALES, 1)) * 100, 2) END AS growthRate FROM MONTHS M LEFT JOIN lastYearSales LY ON TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(M.monthS, 'YYYY-MM'), 'MM') = LY.month LEFT JOIN thisYearSales TY ON TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(M.monthS, 'YYYY-MM'), 'MM') = TY.month ORDER BY M.monthS )T4 ON(T1.MONTH_LIST = T4.MONTHS)
